strings.name: Sergio Ermotti
strings.summary: Ermotti rose from a banking apprenticeship through Citibank, Merrill Lynch and UniCredit. He led UBS in 2011–2020, emphasizing wealth management, then chaired Swiss Re. Returning to UBS in 2023, he led Credit Suisse integration. He remained CEO when reviewed in 2026; succession was still prospective.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Reshaped UBS’s wealth-management and investment-banking balance and led integration after the Credit Suisse acquisition.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Banking apprenticeship; Swiss banking-expert diploma; Oxford Advanced Management Program.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Strategic restructuring
strings.highlights.h1.text: Prioritized wealth management and reduced investment-bank risk in his first tenure.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Credit Suisse integration
strings.highlights.h2.text: Returned in 2023 to lead the acquired bank’s integration.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Succession remains prospective
strings.timeline.t1.text: UBS said he would stay until at least early 2027; departure speculation was premature.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Returns to UBS
strings.timeline.t2.text: Replaced Ralph Hamers as CEO to lead Credit Suisse integration.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Chairs Swiss Re
strings.timeline.t3.text: Became chairman, leaving in 2023 upon his UBS return.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Becomes permanent UBS CEO
strings.timeline.t4.text: Moved from interim leadership into the permanent position.
strings.timeline.t5.title: UniCredit deputy CEO
strings.timeline.t5.text: Oversaw corporate, investment and private banking.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joins UniCredit
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became head of markets and investment banking.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joins Merrill Lynch
strings.timeline.t7.text: Began a long period in equity derivatives and capital markets.
